title: Concept: Travelling-salesman tour
body: A combinatorial problem that asks for the shortest cycle visiting each city once and returning to the start.

title: Concept: Quantum-inspired genetic algorithm
body: A population search that borrows quantum state and gate metaphors to encode and update candidate tours.

title: Concept: Classical genetic algorithm
body: A population heuristic using selection, crossover, and mutation to improve candidate tours.

title: Concept: TSPLIB benchmarks
body: A standard library of tour instances used to compare algorithms across sizes and structures.

title: Concept: Rotation-angle tuning
body: The gate angle that controls how candidates change; the paper identifies it as a key tuning burden.

title: Claim: Experiments
body: On the tested TSPLIB instances, the classical genetic algorithm usually converged to better tours faster than the quantum-inspired variant.

title: Claim: Limitations
body: The quantum-inspired results come from simulation; no real quantum hardware was evaluated.
